name: A Hole New World: Deluxe Edition
storyline: The city is being invaded by monsters pouring in from the Upside Down World. The Potion Master sets out to confront this evil alone, relying on the help of a companion fairy named Fäy and an arsenal of potions to turn back the invasion.
summary:
This edition includes:

- A Hole New World base game.
- A Hole New World Soundtrack.
